The aforementioned FIR is inter alia concerned with the alleged forgery of the Original Agreement to Sell vide UTR No.BARBR520151026007674757 dated 26th October, 2015 with respect to the property which is agricultural land admeasuring 2 bighas and 8 biswas, bearing Mustakil No.3, Killa Nos. 21/1 (1-4) and 21/2Min (1-4) situated in Jonapur, Tehsil Mehrauli, New Delhi.

In the said FIR, it has been alleged that the title deeds of various properties were deposited as security against loans advanced to the complainant/Sh. Amrish Gupta, who is the husband of the Seema Gupta vs Sunny Talwani on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60609440/

It is submitted that the learned Trial Court in CR Cases 3324/2020 titled as State v. Gurchait Singh Chima & Ors, arising out of FIR No. 27/2018 at Police Station EOW, vide its order dated 11th November, 2021, observed that, in the facts and circumstances of the case, cognizance of offence is deferred till further orders or filing of supplementary chargesheet whichever is earlier.

On 3rd January, 2022, pursuant to directions of the learned Trial Court, the EOW wrote a letter dated 3rd January, 2022 to the learned Registrar General, Delhi High Court with a request to provide original Agreements to Sale but the request was not entertained.
